meta.source: lamikraft.in brand site + reference boards, built by Claude for Neelaj Debnath

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background in both themes: warm paper in light, warm near-black in dark. Everything else floats over it.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: the sidebar rail track, inset input fields, the area behind a modal's glass.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque card and menu fill where blur is unavailable or unwanted (print, dense tables, inside another glass panel).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, menus and popovers that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The frosted panel fill: pair with `backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md))`. 65% white in light, 6% white in dark. Never put text directly on glass without checking it against the ground it floats over.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for panels that carry body text or sit over busy imagery (85% white light, 12% white dark).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px rim of every glass panel and the hairline between stacked glass layers. Decorative: not relied on for meaning.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: The 1px inner top-edge highlight inside glass (`inset 0 1px 0`) that sells the bevel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and icons on `ground`, `surface`, `glass` and `glass-strong`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table cells, descriptions, nav labels, on the same grounds as `ink`.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, timestamps, placeholders, axis labels, on `ground`, `surface` and glass (4.5:1 minimum in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Disabled text and purely decorative glyphs only: below 4.5:1 by design, never for content.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The black-pill surface from the monochrome references: inverse buttons, the dock nav, selected segments, dark feature cards. Flips to ivory in dark.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rules, card outlines (8% ink). Decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline for grouped controls and hover outlines (16% ink). Decorative.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders in their resting state: 3:1 against `surface` and `ground` in both themes so the control reads without a fill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one brand accent (Lamikraft amber). Fills only in light: primary buttons, active indicators, selection, the focus ring in dark, progress. As text it passes only in dark; in light use `gold-strong`.

tokens.name: gold-strong
tokens.usage: Gold as text and links on `ground`, `surface`, glass and `gold-soft`; the focus ring in light. 5.3:1 on `ground` light.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind gold text: selected rows, active chips, the AI assistant's quiet state.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `gold` fill: always dark ink, never white (7.2:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: The board's wood tone from the logo. Illustration, chart fills and large ambient blobs only; never text, never the primary action.

tokens.name: sand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for imagery frames and product cards.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Success fills, the leaf from the logo: progress complete, positive deltas, online dots. Paired with a check or word, never hue alone.

tokens.name: leaf-text
tokens.usage: Success as text on `surface`, `ground` and `leaf-soft`.

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text and badges.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Danger and destructive fills (brand terracotta). Differs from `leaf` in lightness in both themes, so the pair is safe for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Danger as text and error messages on `surface`, `ground` and `ember-soft`.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text and invalid inputs.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning fills and dots: yellow, deliberately lighter than `gold` so the two never read as one.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text on `surface`, `ground` and `amber-soft`.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Information fills and the chart's cool series; the hue of the AI orb at rest.

tokens.name: cobalt-text
tokens.usage: Information as text on `surface`, `ground` and `cobalt-soft`.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind information text.

tokens.name: aurora-1
tokens.usage: Aurora stop 1 (gold). The warm-to-cool aurora is reserved for the AI composer, the orb's halo and AI-generated content; never decorate ordinary surfaces with it.

tokens.name: aurora-2
tokens.usage: Aurora stop 2 (coral).

tokens.name: aurora-3
tokens.usage: Aurora stop 3 (orchid).

tokens.name: aurora-4
tokens.usage: Aurora stop 4 (cobalt).

tokens.name: aurora-5
tokens.usage: Aurora stop 5 (cyan).

tokens.name: orb-deep
tokens.usage: The AI orb's deep navy body.

tokens.name: orb-mid
tokens.usage: The AI orb's mid-tone blue.

tokens.name: orb-glow
tokens.usage: The AI orb's cyan crescent and halo.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series (an alias of gold).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series: ink, so the two main series differ in lightness, not hue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third data series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth data series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth data series (coral).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Sixth series and 'other' buckets: neutral grey.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis rules; an alias-strength hairline.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface. 5.3:1 light, 9.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind modals and sheets (40% ink light, 60% black dark).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero and cover lines, one or two words per line. Italic for the one emphasised word.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Dashboard page titles and welcome lines.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Section titles inside glass panels and big empty states.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title when the serif display would be too loud (dense ERP screens).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Precision-crafted products built to perform and endure.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Antimicrobial surface, HACCP compliant, dishwasher safe.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy, helper text, dense table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, nav items, chip text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes and axis labels, in `ink-3`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels, uppercase (`text-transform: uppercase`), in `ink-3` or `gold-strong`.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tiles and chart callouts; tabular numerals.

styles.name: stat-sm
styles.usage: Inline metrics and table totals; tabular numerals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: SKUs, order IDs, codes and keyboard shortcuts in a mono face.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Tiny data readouts: durations, coordinates, axis ticks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inside pills, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on compact tiles, gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Glass panel padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a dashboard grid; section padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large panel padding, modal padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding, page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The collapsed sidebar rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The top bar.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button and input height.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large button, hero CTA, composer height.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tiny tags, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, table thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menu items, inner cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, list cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Glass panels (default), modals, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and the app shell's outer frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, the dock nav, avatars, switches.

shadow.note: Shadows are soft, long and warm; glass panels get an inner top highlight. Never a hard drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass panel at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A glass panel on hover or while dragged; popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Modals, sheets and the dock nav.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-well
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: sliders tracks, the rail's track, search fields on glass.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-gold
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and the selected card.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-orb
tokens.usage: The AI orb while listening or thinking.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii for glass. Always pair with `saturate(1.4)` and the matching glass token.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, pills and small floating controls on glass.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Glass panels and cards (default).

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: The top bar, sidebar and modals over busy content.

tokens.name: blur-xl
tokens.usage: The aurora backdrop and ambient colour blobs behind a page.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Whole disabled controls.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Ink overlay on hovered rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Ink overlay while pressed.

tokens.name: opacity-aurora
tokens.usage: The aurora field's maximum strength behind the composer; 0.3 in light theme hero use.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, hovered cards.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Top bar, sidebar, dock nav.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, selects.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Scrim and modal.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

duration.note: Motion is liquid and unhurried: enter with ease-out-expo, exit faster, ambient loops over seconds. Honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by collapsing ambient loops to a still frame.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover colour and opacity.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Pressed states, chip toggles, switch thumbs.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels appearing, tabs sliding, tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Modals, page transitions, number count-ups.

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: One cycle of the aurora drift or orb breathing.

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Anything entering or growing: panels, menus, hover lift.

tokens.name: ease-in-quart
tokens.usage: Anything leaving.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Switch thumbs, segmented control pills, the dock's active bubble (slight overshoot).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity changes.
